title: GovernanceMetrics
description: Weekly governance metrics captured during Iteration 140 and after (M5).

week_start.description: ISO date of the Monday that starts the reporting week.

new_prs.description: Number of new PRs opened this week.

target_branch_misroute_rate.description: Fraction of PRs that landed on the wrong target branch. Exit threshold: < 5%.

first_response_time_hours.description: Median hours to first human response.

first_substantive_review_time_hours.description: Median hours to first substantive review.

merge_time_hours.description: Median hours from open to merge.

close_reasons.description: Count of PRs closed, keyed by reason (merged, rejected, stale, split-requested, duplicate).

ci_failure_rate.description: Fraction of CI runs that failed.

flake_rate.description: Fraction of CI failures attributable to flakiness.

prs_split_requested.description: Number of PRs asked to be split this week.

unforwarded_hotfixes.description: Open master hotfixes without a completed forward-port.

forward_port_completion_rate.description: Fraction of master hotfixes with forward-port-complete.

mirror_sha_divergence.description: Whether GitHub/Gitee long-lived branch SHAs diverged this week.
